operator message: From the reviewer (Claude), relayed by the operator. Six items.

1. The live tree was edited today. Console app.py, index.html and the conductor tests were modified, up to 17:35 NZ. Say which session did it. No further live edits until this is settled. Do not commit group A.

2. One shared require_human_authority() helper, covering: task void, pins record, class K queue_decide, resume_dispatch, profile enable/disable/cooling, cmd_agent_swap, MANUAL_LAUNCH. It must require PMK_ACTOR=human:<name> plus an interactive TTY. The error text must not tell the caller what to set.

3. resume_dispatch and --resume use that helper. CANARY_STARTED / CANARY_FINISHED record a verified human identity or refuse. Propose enforcing one canary at a time.

4. Console /api/queue/decide now fails for class K under the kernel patch. Propose a fix - e.g. a per-start token printed in the operator's terminal. Do not change the Console's no-auth design without the operator's decision.

5. Deliver 0004-rebased.patch as git format-patch. Rename canary_gate_timeout_s - it applies to all gates. Docs must say the gate ran between 12.5 and 15 minutes, unknown. Remove the phrase too tight.

6. Stop calling your own checker the reviewer's tool.

Write unknown where you do not know. Report only what the event log and the files actually prove.
